merge.name: orders_get
merge.description: Returns one order with its line items, totals in cents, coupon and notes. Pass either id or number (for example ORD-10042, case-insensitive). Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

merge.name: products_get
merge.description: Returns one product, including its current price and whether it is still sold. Pass either id or sku (for example SKU-0042, case-insensitive). Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.

merge.name: shipments_get
merge.description: Returns carrier, tracking number, status and the shipped, estimated and delivered dates of one shipment. Pass either id or trackingNumber (for example TRK00000010). Allowed roles: any signed-in staff role.
